problems_and_friction: The patch-data command requires attribution flags (--agent, --action) that are not mentioned in the protocol; the first attempt failed. The protocol also says to call patch-decision separately, but patch-data already records a decision when attribution flags are provided — this results in a duplicate decision entry, which is benign but slightly redundant.
